description: Clean up remaining pages (Insights, Review, Mistakes, Learn) and add tabs to consolidated pages. Ensure the Insights page absorbs the Weekly Report and LOS Tracker content via a tab interface. Clean up page spacing and visual hierarchy across all remaining protected routes.
steps: Refactor src/app/(protected)/insights/page.tsx: Add a tab interface (Overview | Weekly Report | LOS Tracker). The Overview tab shows the existing InsightsContent. The Weekly Report tab renders WeeklyReportContent. The LOS Tracker tab renders LOSTrackerContent. This consolidates 3 separate pages into one. Create a shared TabsNav component at src/shared/components/ui/tabs-nav.tsx for reuse.

Since the existing /weekly-report and /los-tracker routes must still work (bookmarks etc), update those page.tsx files to redirect or simply render the same content but link to the Insights page tabs for a unified experience. Add a subtle banner: 'This is now part of Insights' with a link.

Clean up src/app/(protected)/review/page.tsx: Already fairly clean, just ensure spacing and whitespace are consistent. Remove the mx-auto max-w-4xl from review since the layout already handles max-width, or ensure it matches other pages.
Clean up src/app/(protected)/mistakes/page.tsx: Already clean, just verify consistent spacing.

Clean up src/app/(protected)/learn/page.tsx: Add slightly more spacing between the grid items (gap-4 instead of gap-3). Ensure the hardcoded colors (text-white, text-zinc-400, border-zinc-800) use CSS variable equivalents for theme consistency.
Update RelatedActions on Insights page to only show 2 relevant items.
Apply consistent header spacing (space-y-8 between major sections) across all modified pages.
acceptance_criteria: Insights page has a working tab interface with 3 tabs (Overview, Weekly Report, LOS Tracker)
Existing /weekly-report and /los-tracker routes still render without errors
TabsNav component is reusable and exported from src/shared/components/ui/tabs-nav.tsx
Learn page uses CSS variables instead of hardcoded zinc colors
All pages have consistent spacing and visual hierarchy
TypeScript compiles, lint passes, build succeeds, tests pass
verification: rm -rf .next && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
findings: All pre-existing lint errors are in other files (subject-progress-indicators.tsx, dashboard-content.tsx, etc.) not related to this feature. Build, tsc, and all 274 tests pass cleanly. The Insights page is now a client component with tabs; metadata export was removed as expected.
